query: My TechCorp Nexa A14/A15 screen suddenly went completely black on its own after about a month of use. It doesn't display anything, even when I try to turn it on.

contexts.goal: Follow these steps to perform this Black Screen Troubleshooting
contexts.title: Black screen recovery

actions.description: It will perform a forced reboot to clear temporary faults causing black screen

steps: Press and hold the Volume Down button and the Side key simultaneously for 7 seconds.
The device will vibrate and restart.
If the screen remains black, charge the device for at least 30 minutes and try again.

actionableDeeplink.description: Force restart requires hardware button combination and cannot be triggered by a deeplink.

actions.actionName: Enable Double Tap to Wake Screen
actions.description: It will allow the display to wake without pressing the physical power button

steps: Toggle on Double tap to turn on screen.

actionableDeeplink.description: Enables double tap to wake screen via device Settings on the device.
actionableDeeplink.message: Enable double tap to turn on screen

validationDeeplink.key: Double tap to turn on screen

actions.description: It will secure your personal files before a hardware service appointment

steps: If the screen activates temporarily, immediately navigate to Settings.
Tap Back up data and run a full backup.
Contact TechCorp Support to schedule a display inspection.

actionableDeeplink.description: Enables data backup to TechCorp Cloud via device Settings on the device.
